name: @learn/visual-tools
description: visual-tools: custom subagent tools (write/edit/render for Mermaid and SVG). Loaded into child sessions by pi-subagents via the mermaid-maker / svg-maker agents' `subagentOnlyExtensions` frontmatter. `typebox` and `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` are provided by pi itself (virtual modules), so they are intentionally NOT dependencies here.
